text: {"rules":[],"notes":"Part 2 of 2 of M.G.L. c. 151B, § 4 contains only provisions on credit age limits, employment discrimination (handicap, sexual harassment, seniority, retirement, genetic information), and sexual harassment by housing providers (subsection 18). None of these set rent increase limits, just-cause eviction rules, security deposit rules, application or screening fee caps, screening restrictions on criminal history, source of income or credit, or algorithmic rent-setting limits. Subsection 18 is a general anti-harassment rule, not a screening restriction, so it is out of scope."}
